summary: Mako Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing its Q1 2026 financial results. The release reports record revenue of $68.6 million, net income of $0.26 per share, and adjusted EBITDA of $40.1 million. It discloses operational data from the San Albino and Moss mines, with gold sales of 13,721 oz at an average realized price of $4,902/oz. The company had $96.1 million in cash and no debt beyond a gold stream. CEO commentary highlights growth plans. This is a routine quarterly earnings filing, not a special-situation event. No transaction or structural change is announced.
